text:
olivia: mid-pairing today my home WiFi folded like a lawn chair. pic: <https://i.imgur.com/cablemess.jpg|cablemess.jpg> someone send good vibes (and a power cycle) :pray:
ben: same here earlier. ISP said 'blip'. told them i'm running mission-critical meme uploads. they were not moved. :laughing:
tara: mesh helped me a ton. netgear or eero depending on budget. also try moving the router off the floor 4aa
infra-bot: Reminder: no infra maintenance impacting home connections from cloud provider in the last 24h. :satellite:
lucas: if you have coax and crap modem, consider MoCA adapters for wired backbone between rooms. cheap and stable for game + dev sessions.
it-support: quick checklist: 1) power-cycle modem+router, 2) check for ISP outage map, 3) try a USB tether to phone to confirm it's local vs ISP. DM us if you want remote troubleshooting.
maya: also, unplugging unused smart plugs cut down interference for me. also post-cat pic when comms restored pls.
zane: I made a tiny script to auto-restart my router on packet loss: `while ping -c 10 1.1.1.1 | grep -q '100% packet loss'; do ssh user@router 'reboot'; sleep 60; done` not for everyone but saved my sanity once. :computer:
olivia: haha love the hack. tried phone tether and it worked so it's ISP for sure. called support, they gave me a ticket number 9f0. swapping to backup tether for now. will post an "after" desk + cat victory photo when this is over. :cat:
